headline: Meeting cancelled; no agenda business will be taken up.
summary: The only item is a notice that the regular meeting has been cancelled. Questions can go to the Land Use Office at 860-584-6225, and the next regular meeting is set for January 5, 2027.
plain_text:
City of Bristol 
Zoning Board of Appeals 
 
REGULAR MEETING OF 
DECEMBER 1, 2026 
 
 
 
  
1. Meeting Cancellation Notice 
 a. This is to advise you that the Regular Meeting of the Zoning Board of 
Appeals (ZBA) scheduled for Tuesday, December 1, 2026 at 6:00 PM 
has been CANCELLED. 
  
The next regularly scheduled meeting of the Zoning Board of Appeals 
is Tuesday, January 5, 2027.  
 
Should you have any questions, please contact the Land Use Office 
at 860-584-6225.
